instrument: Michigan City data center moratorium and zoning review
summary: The council voted 8-1 on September 15, 2026 to table the proposed moratorium indefinitely, including the accompanying zoning review.
notes: Recorded as void because the instrument was tabled indefinitely rather than adopted, lapsed or rejected outright. Second of two reversals recorded this week.
